name: How long does it take to install new slip-resistant shower flooring?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new slip-resistant shower flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for new slip-resistant shower flooring depends on the scope of the project. If it's part of a larger bathroom remodel, the flooring portion might take 1-3 days, including prep, setting, and grout curing. For a standalone replacement of shower flooring, it could be completed within a few days. Factors like existing substrate conditions, material type (e.g., tile vs. pre-fabricated pan), and drying times for thin-set and grout will influence the total duration. Your contractor can provide a more precise estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes 1-3 days, depending on project scope, material, and drying times, but varies by project.
